Class TerrainChunk

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.terrain.TerrainChunk
public final class TerrainChunk extends Object
Renderable terrain chunk assembled from worker-generated mesh data. generate(int, int, TerrainGenerator, int, int, float, float, float) creates terrain, rock, and tree mesh data on worker threads; the constructor creates engine meshes and geometry on the render thread. Grass is generated on demand as the camera approaches.

Call generate(int, int, TerrainGenerator, int, int, float, float, float) on a worker thread, then construct the chunk and attach its geometries on the render thread.

    • generate

      public static TerrainChunk.Data generate(int chunkX, int chunkZ, TerrainGenerator generator, int size, int subdivisions, float waterHeight, float rockDensity, float rockSizeScale)
      Computes chunk vertex data, blend maps, and optional rocks without creating engine scene objects. Samples a (side + 2) × (side + 2) height grid once, deriving normals from neighboring samples. World-space sampling keeps shared borders consistent across chunks. The RGB blend map stores continuous weights for base grass (R), sand (G), and gravel (B).
      Parameters:
      chunkX - horizontal chunk coordinate on the world X axis
      chunkZ - horizontal chunk coordinate on the world Z axis
      generator - seeded world terrain generator
      size - chunk width and depth in world units
      subdivisions - grid-cell count along each chunk edge
      waterHeight - world-space water-plane height used for surface blending
      rockDensity - requested density of main rocks in rocky areas
      rockSizeScale - rock size multiplier
      Returns:
      generated buffers and height samples
